title: Tio's teaching: counting divisions and 'stealing' notes
summary: Gorman recalls Tio's advice that musicians steal time from notes, how to count eighth and sixteenth divisions, and Tio's foot-patting.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees
